find: if (ev !== av) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
replace: if (ev?.trim() !== av?.trim()) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
killedBy: the screen baseline: role and aria attributes are compared exactly (issue #937) fails a renamed accessible name, and does not trim a value to make it match
why: Trims each attribute before comparing, so a value that changed only in whitespace reads as unchanged. The gate compares the app's own string, exactly like text: box geometry gets a tolerance because rasterisers differ, and an attribute is not a rasteriser reading. Whether a given whitespace change is audible is not decided here (an id list is split on whitespace, and the computed accessible name is trimmed); the gate reports the DOM change and leaves that judgement to the reader of the diff.
